description: This source file defines the MacroTokenParser class for parsing macro definitions within the Twig templating engine. It handles the parsing of macro blocks, argument lists, and validates default argument values.

classes.name: MacroTokenParser
classes.description: A final class responsible for parsing macro blocks in Twig templates, including argument list processing and scope management.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a macro block and registers the macro node in the parser context.

methods.name: decideBlockEnd
methods.description: Determines if the current token signifies the end of a macro block.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag associated with this token parser ('macro').

methods.name: parseDefinition
methods.description: Parses the list of macro arguments, including default values.

methods.name: checkConstantExpression
methods.description: Recursively verifies that a node only contains constant expressions.
